records.institution: Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
records.duration_as_published: One year (1200 hours + 150 hours OJT/Group Project)

modules.title_verbatim: Identify metrological instruments and understand the diversity within the profession of nursery & orchard management following safety precautions.
Manage effectively a plant nursery, including tasks such as seed propagation, plant care, pest management to produce and maintain healthy, high-quality plants.

Apply various methods of plant propagation, including seed sowing, cuttings, grafting and division to produce new plants, maintain genetic diversity and contribute to sustainable plant cultivation and horticultural practices.
Perform Temperate Fruit Growing and Perform Fruit Plant Nursery Raising.
Plan and establish an Orchard and Perform General Cultural Practices related to soil.
Identify different diseases and pests required for mitigate the same.
Plan, install different irrigation systems, Water lifting systems and of water quality and perform different methods of irrigation.
Analyze Soil water holding capacity, Different methods and ingredient used for correction of Saline soil also visit Field for identification of soil problems.
Plan and execute different soil correction method through drainage and agronomic practices.
Measure Soil fertility and apply soil Fertility management for improvement of fertility of soil.
Apply integrated nutrient Management system (INMS) in the field and identify, prepare and apply Bio- fertilizers.
Identify the role of major and minor plant nutrients and its deficiency symptoms.
Develop the Cultivation techniques and methods of different fruits.
Identify and select different Vegetative propagation method and perform propagation techniques of cutting, grafting, budding and layering.
Perform Vines, Nuts and Berries culture, execute different mulching methods.
Perform Cultural Management of a Fruit Plantation in Orchard by practicing various pruning activity and interpret marketing of Horticulture produces.
